final_answer:
>>> The Rosetta Stone is significant because it provided the key to deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphics, which had been a mystery for centuries.  
>>> It contains the same text written in three scripts—Ancient Greek, Demotic, and hieroglyphics—allowing scholars to compare and decode the meaning of hieroglyphic symbols.  
>>> Jean-François Champollion was pivotal; he used his knowledge of Coptic (a descendant of ancient Egyptian) and Greek to match hieroglyphic characters to known words, proving hieroglyphics were phonetic and symbolic.  
>>> This breakthrough unlocked Egypt’s history, religion, and culture, transforming our understanding of ancient civilizations.
